title: automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap and private-installer Helm/Terraform integration
author: Ethan Park
description:
Motivation: Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) require deterministic, auditable RBAC bootstrapping so tenant operators can be created and upgraded without manual cluster admin intervention. This PR automates generation and application of tenant-scoped Roles/RoleBindings during the private-installer flow, plugs RBAC templates into the Helm chart values, and aligns the Terraform module to provision the installer service account and necessary cloud IAM bindings.

What this PR does:
- Adds an idempotent tenant bootstrap script (cmd/tenant-bootstrap) used by the private-installer and the Helm post-install hook to ensure tenant CRs and Tenant-scoped RBAC objects exist. The script is safe to run multiple times and supports dry-run and rollback modes.
- Introduces Helm values and templates under charts/private-installer/templates/rbac-templates.yaml to render per-tenant Role and RoleBinding manifests when tenant annotations are present. Chart changes are guarded behind values.rbac.enable_tenant_templates (default: false) to avoid unexpected cluster changes.
- Updates terraform/modules/installer to create a k8s ServiceAccount for the installer, a ClusterRole for bootstrap operations (limited privileges: create/update Tenant CRs, create Role/RoleBinding in tenant namespaces), and cloud IAM bindings needed on GCP/AWS to let the installer rotate keys for encrypted secrets.
- Adds migration scripts for upgrades in installers/upgrade that detect older RBAC layout and migrate to tenant-scoped roles while preserving existing permissions via a two-step canary rollout.
- Adds unit tests for tenant-bootstrap and chart rendering; integration test harness included in perf-canary that runs a minimal private-installer deployment in CI.

Checklist:
- [x] Idempotent tenant bootstrap binary and docs
- [x] Helm chart values + templates with feature flag
- [x] Terraform changes to provision installer SA + limited ClusterRole
- [x] Migration/rollback scripts and canary rollout plan
- [x] Unit & integration tests added
- [x] Docs: private-installer/README and ops/runbooks updated

Testing and CI:
- Local unit tests: all passing.
- Integration CI (private-installer e2e): initially flaky due to kubeconfig propagation; fixed by adding SA token refresh in terraform module. Final CI status: pass.
- Manual verification: deployed to an internal staging VPC, created a tenant via the installer, verified that tenant namespaces received Roles/RoleBindings scoped to the tenant and that the installer SA did not retain cluster-admin.

Backward compatibility and rollout:
- Default behavior preserved: new tenant RBAC templates are disabled by default. Installer upgrade path will run migration only when values.rbac.enable_migration=true to allow operator-controlled migration windows. The migration is reversible via the provided rollback mode in tenant-bootstrap.

Ops notes for operators:
- To enable automatic tenant RBAC templates during chart installs, set values.rbac.enable_tenant_templates=true and ensure terraform has created the installer SA with the new ClusterRole.
- For upgrades, set values.rbac.enable_migration=true on the release and monitor tenant-bootstrap logs. A canary rollout is recommended (the upgrade script supports --canary-namespaces).

Related work: ENG-3121 (tenant isolation design), ENG-3180 (private-installer automation), SUP-908 (customer issue where installer required manual cluster-admin).

release_notes: Automated tenant RBAC bootstrap for private-installer (opt-in via values.rbac.enable_tenant_templates & values.rbac.enable_migration). Includes Terraform changes to provision installer SA and limited ClusterRole, Helm templates for tenant-scoped Roles/RoleBindings, and migration/rollback tooling. Operators must enable the feature and run a canary before cluster-wide rollout.
